name: Image-Based Localization (Floc)
definition: Finds the grid cell in the RNR-Map closest to a target image $I_{trg}$ by comparing latent codes, outputting a heatmap $E$ and predicted orientation $a_{trg}$.
summary: Image-Based Localization (Floc) locates an agent in a Renderable Neural Radiance Map using a single query image and latent codes, offering faster real-time performance by eliminating rendering.
